kernel_progress_by_capture_region.scoping: Partitioned by received milestone lines; collector order does not align host and app clocks. Per-job lifetime maxima are not phase durations or CPU time.

limits: A/B/A changes only the initial full startup prewarm environment selection in the same application artifact. The new artifact also contains other source changes, so an older-application comparison is not a single-variable experiment.
One selected-prewarm trial and two deferred trials are a small observation set; network, remote service state, caches and scheduling may vary.
Application elapsed_ms and host mono_ms have separate origins. No total is inferred by adding the host loader duration to an app endpoint.
Nested/concurrent durations overlap and must not be summed. Poll time and scheduler slices measure wall time, not CPU time.
An await span with small measured polls can include callee execution, dependency/lock waiting, scheduling delay or remote latency outside its own polls.
Raw paint spans have no Future poll measurement; zero polls does not imply zero rendering work.
The private watermark-off experiment was reverted before these trials; production success watermarks remain enabled on this instrumented-off kernel.
Only recognized startup/progress fields and controlled metadata are retained; no prompts were submitted.

The first full-prewarm attempt panicked during dotenv before Tokio/runtime policy selection. Its zero-width harness capture reflects the launch timeout; the separately frozen collector window records the actual request and sanitized failure. It is excluded from policy-performance comparisons.

The pre-skills-fix deferred baseline followed a later reset with the same cdff selection. It observed a separate cold SQLite request2 and is an additional control, not a warm matched A/B member; the SQLite service was retained warm for later application trials.
